_README: The combat tuning numbers, and the ONE place they live.
sim/ is the authority on the RULES and is written in C#. Godot's web
export cannot run C# (Godot 4 dropped it when it moved from Mono to
.NET Core, and it has not come back), and the web export is the whole
reason the developer can play builds on a phone. So prototype/ mirrors
Duplicated logic is a real cost and it is accepted deliberately, but
duplicated NUMBERS are not: tuning is what changes daily once someone
has a controller, and two drifting copies of it would be poison. Both
sides read this file. TuningFileTests.cs fails the build if it stops
matching the C# defaults, so drift cannot happen quietly.
Every value here is a placeholder with the right relationships between
them. combat.md section 9: feel is judged with a controller, never
